name: 86 Chaos 17.0.17
label: 86 Chaos 17.0.17
notes: Prevents damaged-checkout recovery from recursively enumerating every untracked dependency file when .gitignore is missing.
Uses directory-level untracked Git status reporting so generated trees such as node_modules are classified without overflowing child-process output buffers.
Still detects real untracked source files inside tracked source directories and refuses meaningful source edits before overlay.
Preserves automatic ZIP extraction, self-heal recovery, streamed release checks, bounded timeouts, process-tree cleanup, immutable deployment verification, and the full Play Store gate.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.17
summary: Repairs the automatic installer failure caused by git status recursively dumping a large untracked node_modules tree when .gitignore is missing.
description: Makes repository safety inspection bounded and generated-artifact aware so the validated app-only ZIP can actually overlay and restore a damaged checkout without weakening source-edit protection.
